svg.title: GitHub telemetry for @hvidom
svg.desc: 550 contributions in the last 12 months (369 of them in private repositories), 157 public commits, current streak 3 days, longest streak 6 days, 803 repositories including the legacy @Frikadellios account, on GitHub since 2019. Top languages: TypeScript 33.6%, HTML 27.7%, Astro 22.3%, Vue 5.8%, CSS 4.7%, JavaScript 3.1%, Other 2.8%.
